editorial_note: Curated sky guides tied to real VSOP87 calculations — never generic horoscope filler.

stories.title: Your birth chart is not your sun sign
stories.dek: Most apps stop at one placement. A real natal chart computes every planet, house, and aspect for the exact minute you arrived — that's what makes it yours alone.
body: Your sun sign is one line in a document with dozens. The moon moves sign every two and a half days; the rising sign changes every two hours. A chart born at 14:02 is not the same chart as one born at 18:47 on the same day.
Astro Precise uses VSOP87 — the same planetary mathematics observatories use — entirely in your browser. No server stores your birth data; the calculation stays on your device.
Start with date, time, and place. The more precise your birth time, the more accurate your rising sign and house cusps — the parts of the chart most personal to you.
tips: If birth time is unknown, still cast — but treat the rising as approximate.
Save your chart locally; return visits personalise the homepage.
Compare your Big Three (Sun, Moon, Rising) before reading planet-by-planet.

stories.title: Why your rising sign needs your birth time
stories.dek: The ascendant is the eastern horizon at your first breath — it moves a degree every four minutes. Without a time, you're reading someone else's chart.
body: The rising sign (ascendant) is the zodiac degree on the eastern horizon at birth. It sets the whole house system — which life areas each planet rules in your chart.
A noon-default chart can show a rising sign that never existed at your birthplace. Astro Precise labels uncertain placements honestly when time is missing.
If you only know morning or evening, narrow the window and note the uncertainty. Family records, birth certificates, and hospital notes are worth chasing.
tips: Rectification is advanced — start with the best time you have.
The rising colours first impressions; the moon colours emotional life.
House cusps shift with latitude — place of birth matters.

stories.title: Living with the moon's rhythm
stories.dek: The moon changes sign every 2–3 days and phase every 29.5 days. Tracking both beats generic 'new moon manifestation' posts.
body: Moon sign colours the emotional weather; moon phase colours momentum. A waxing moon in earth signs favours building; a waning moon in water signs favours release — but your natal moon always filters the story.
Astro Precise computes tonight's moon from the same ephemeris as your natal chart, so daily sky and personal chart speak the same language.
Pair moon phase with transits to your natal moon for timing that is actually about your chart, not a collective meme.
tips: Check moon sign before important conversations.
Void-of-course moon is a pause signal, not a superstition.
Natal moon sign is your baseline; transiting moon is the weather.

stories.title: Transits: when the sky touches your chart
stories.dek: A transit is a planet in today's sky aspecting a planet in your natal chart. Generic forecasts ignore which houses they hit — yours don't.
body: Saturn squaring your natal Venus means something different at 22 than at 52 because your chart's house structure differs. Transit reports must know your chart.
Astro Precise dates major transits to your saved chart using real ephemeris positions — not approximations from sun-sign columns.
Outer-planet transits are slow; inner-planet transits are the weekly weather. Both matter, on different clocks.
tips: Save your chart once — transits reference it automatically.
Note exact dates when a transit peaks; the feeling often lags.
Retrograde periods re-hit the same degrees three times.

stories.title: Synastry without the soulmate myth
stories.dek: Comparing two charts shows where energies meet — harmony, friction, and blind spots. It is a map, not a verdict.
body: Synastry overlays two natal wheels and measures aspects between them. Conjunctions fuse; squares demand work; trines flow easily — all of them teach something.
Astro Precise computes both charts with VSOP87, then scores aspect patterns honestly. No fabricated compatibility percentages.
Composite charts (the relationship as its own entity) are a second lens — useful for long partnerships, not a replacement for individual charts.
tips: Compare Big Three before diving into every minor aspect.
Friction aspects are not 'bad' — they show growth edges.
Both birth times improve house-overlay accuracy.

stories.title: Retrograde seasons — what actually shifts
stories.dek: When a planet appears to move backward, astrologers track review, delay, and revision themes. The astronomy is real; the meaning is chart-specific.
body: Mercury retrograde is the famous one, but Mars, Venus, and the outer planets retrograde too — each on its own schedule. The key is which natal houses and planets they touch in your chart.
Astro Precise lists station dates from the ephemeris and flags when retrograde planets aspect your saved chart — not a one-size-fits-all warning.
Retrograde is not 'don't do anything.' It is 'double-check, revisit, and finish what you started.'
tips: Note the pre-shadow and post-shadow dates, not just the middle.
Back up devices before Mercury stations — practical, not mystical.
Contracts signed on the station day deserve extra review.

stories.title: Zodiac season is more than a meme
stories.dek: When the Sun enters a new sign, the collective tone shifts — but how it lands in your chart depends on which house the Sun transits for you.
body: Sun in Cancer season warms home and family themes globally; for you it might activate career or partnerships depending on your house cusps.
Read the season briefing, then check transits to your natal Sun and Ascendant for the personal layer.
Astro Precise sign pages pair daily horoscope text with real planetary positions — not recycled paragraphs.
tips: Read your rising-sign horoscope for daily tone.
Season ingress is a good day to set one intention.
Compare season themes to your solar return chart.

stories.title: From chart to story — not a report
stories.dek: Your Cosmic Story weaves six movements from your real placements using the interpretation corpus — a narrative, not a bullet list.
body: Most apps dump planet-in-sign snippets. A story connects Sun, Moon, rising, and temperament into something you can feel and remember.
Astro Precise builds the narrative from your saved chart or a live demo — every sentence traces to a computed placement.
Read the sample before buying any reading; the shop is honest about what is digital vs print vs pending checkout.
tips: Save your chart first for a fully personal story.
Share the sample link — it uses a real demo chart.
Six movements map to Sun, Moon, Ascendant, mind/heart, temperament, North Node.

stories.title: Privacy-first astrology is possible
stories.dek: Your birth data is intimate. Astro Precise keeps charts in local storage — no account, no cloud upload, no data sale.
body: Many astrology apps ship birth data to servers for 'personalisation.' Here the ephemeris runs client-side; saved charts stay in your browser's storage.
Clearing site data removes saved charts — export or screenshot what you want to keep. We do not have a copy to restore.
That trade-off is deliberate: your sky, your device, your choice.
tips: Screenshot your chart wheel if you clear browser data often.
PWA install keeps the app shell offline — charts still local.
Read the privacy page for the full data posture.

stories.title: Saturn return — the chart's coming-of-age
stories.dek: Around age 29–30 Saturn returns to its natal position. The dates are astronomical; the themes are personal to your Saturn sign and house.
body: Saturn return is not a punishment — it is a structural audit. Career, boundaries, and what you are building long-term surface for review.
Exact dates depend on your natal Saturn degree and whether Saturn retrogrades over it three times.
Astro Precise computes your Saturn placement and transit hits from the ephemeris — check your chart's Saturn sign and house first.
tips: Note exact hit dates in transits — the process can span months.
Saturn sign shows the flavour; Saturn house shows the life area.
Journal commitments you are ready to keep vs release.

stories.title: Mercury in your chart — how you think
stories.dek: Mercury sign and house describe communication style and mental habits. Transit Mercury retrograde reactivates those natal themes.
body: Mercury never travels far from the Sun — your Mercury sign is often the same element as your Sun or one sign away. That is astronomy, not a flaw.
Mercury house shows where you think and talk most: third house is local, ninth is big picture, tenth is public voice.
When Mercury retrogrades, notice which natal houses it crosses — that is the personal retrograde story.
tips: Mercury aspects to Moon affect feeling-thought balance.
Keep a retrograde re-read list — emails, drafts, old projects.
Mercury speed varies; ephemeris shows exact station times.
